subject: OrchardAI pricing pathway & commitment inquiry
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Maya Shah <maya@orchard.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + ask: token run-rate and target $/1M tokens

Hi Maya — thanks again for the demo and the thoughtful discussion earlier today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can get you a clean commercial path: 

Call highlights (quick):
- Primary use: multi-turn customer-solution chat (support + guided workflows).
- Typical prompt length: 250–800 input tokens; responses average 400–1,200 tokens.
- Expected peak concurrency: ~40 requests/sec during business hours; seasonal spikes for launches.

Commercial asks we need to size options and recommend a discount band:
1) Monthly token run-rate: please confirm an expected monthly range (best guess is fine). Example bands you can pick from: 5–20M, 20–80M, 80–250M, 250M+.
2) Target unit economics: what is your target $/1M tokens (ballpark is OK). If you have a target total monthly budget this helps too.
3) Commitment horizon: are you evaluating 12-month committed purchase, 24-month, or pay-as-you-go for now?

From our side, options we typically show:
- Startup program (credit + introductory pricing) for early-stage ARR companies — can combine with a 12-month commit for additional incremental discount.
- Committed-use discount bands: volume-driven tiers (10–25% depending on size & term).
- Multi-year incentives: deeper rebates for 24+ month legal commitments and prepayment.

Attachments: I’ve added an initial mutual plan template (orchardai-mpa-draft.xlsx) and the startup program summary.

Ask: Can you confirm the monthly token range and a target $/1M tokens by EOD tomorrow? That will let Ben scope pricing tiers and Laura start a draft MPA.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Maya Shah <maya@orchard.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 20:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: token run-rate and target $/1M tokens

Soojin — thanks for the clear recap and the materials. Quick answers below so you can sketch scenarios: 

1) Monthly run-rate (expected, month 3+ after launch): 35–60M tokens/month. We’ll likely ramp from 10M in month 1 to that range by month 3.
2) Target unit economics: target $/1M tokens ~ $1,300–$1,500. That’s what we have in the current product budget for hosted LLM spend.
3) Commitment horizon: we prefer to secure predictability — open to a 12-month committed purchase with quarterly milestones; 24-month is possible if there’s a meaningful price step-down.

Notes from Procurement:
- Need SOC 2 report and standard security questionnaire answered before legal can sign MPA.
- We’d like to understand any caps on KV cache or token retention that affect cost.

Also: we are an early-stage Series B team, so the startup program + some credit would help the cadence. Can you outline the startup credit structure vs a straight committed discount?

Best,
Maya
Maya Shah | Head of Product | Orchard AI
maya@orchard.ai | +1 (617) 555-0144

Subject: Re: Recap + ask: token run-rate and target $/1M tokens

Maya — thanks for the quick answers and the budget band. Based on the 35–60M/mo and your target of $1.3k–$1.5k/1M tokens, here are two pragmatic commercial sketches we can formalize: 

Scenario A — 12-month commitment (recommended starter):
- Commit: 600M tokens up front (equivalent to ~50M/mo over 12 months).
- Pricing: baseline price aligned to your target ($1,400/1M) with a 12% committed-use discount -> effective ~$1,232/1M.
- Startup credit: as a Series B customer we can add a one-time $20k credit to the first invoice if you opt into the 12-month commit.
- Deliverables: standard MPA, SOC 2 evidence bundle, and a 30-day rollout support window.

Scenario B — 24-month prepay (deeper savings):
- Commit: 1.2B tokens over 24 months (prepaid or quarterly invoiced).
- Pricing: baseline with a 20% committed discount -> effective ~$1,120/1M.
- Startup credit: $10k credit (smaller since deeper discount already applies).

Other notes:
- We can cap streaming concurrency latency SLOs by instance type and region; for KV cache/token retention we’ll provide a configuration sheet — that’s covered in the technical annex.
- Next steps I recommend: 1) confirm which scenario you prefer; 2) we prepare a draft MPA (I’ll lead pricing language); 3) send SOC 2 and security pack to procurement (we’ll attach to the HubSpot deal).

I’ll loop our legal ops once you indicate preference so we can get a fast turnaround on signatures.

Ben Carter | Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127
